thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: p99 latency alert fired for /v1/embeddings-eu (p99 > 2s for 6m). PD-INC-6721. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/embeddings-eu/p99

devon: acked. I'm on it, looking at pods and recent deploys.

incident-bot: Alert details: spike started 1712499960. Error rate + timeouts increased. Autoscaler events: frequent scale-down then immediate scale-up. Recent config change: autoscaler bump PR #4521 deployed ~1712499800 by maya.

maya: seeing the same. My change lowered minimum replicas during low traffic; looks like edge bursts are driving scale churn. Also noticing envoy-sidecar restarts on several pods.

devon: grabbing node/pod logs. `kubectl get pods -n embeddings-eu -o wide | grep -E "envoy|model-server"` -> a few envoy sidecars in CrashLoopBackOff, reason OOMKilled. Paste of `kubectl describe pod embeddings-xyz`: "OOMKilled: memory limit 256Mi"

sasha: oof. did the autoscaler reduce base to 1? that would make bursts tear through cache and increase memory. recommendation: raise sidecar mem to 512Mi and set min_replicas to 2 while stabilizing.

priya: customer impact check: SLOs for embeddings are 300ms p95 / 1s p99. We already have multiple timed-out requests from two paying customers in EU. Escalate if billing-sensitive.

leo: quick mitigation plan: 1) patch sidecar mem on the failing daemonset, 2) temporarily set min_replicas=2 for embeddings-eu autoscaler, 3) route a subset of traffic to dedicated capacity (ded-emb-01) as fallback. I'll run 1+2 now.

devon: running commands: `kubectl patch ds envoy-sidecar -n embeddings-eu -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"envoy","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"512Mi"}}}]}}}}'` and `kubectl scale --replicas=2 hpa/embeddings-eu`. will monitor.

incident-bot: Action recorded by devon. PagerDuty: acknowledged by devon.

devon: applied patches. sidecars are restarting cleanly, memory usage stabilizing. p95 dropping back toward 350ms, p99 still ~1.6s but trending down. Routing 15% of traffic to ded-emb-01 via router flag.

maya: rolling back the autoscaler change (PR #4521) to revert min-replicas tweak; initiating rollback now.

sasha: thanks — if p99 is still >1s after 10m we should consider model-fallback to quantized-small for non-enterprise traffic. that reduces latency at small quality cost.

priya: notifying account team for the two affected customers. ETA on stabilization?

devon: ETA ~8-12 minutes. I'll continue monitoring. leaving watch on metrics and oncall pager. handing off to sasha @ 1712500245 for follow-up and postmortem. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident update logged: mitigation applied, partial traffic reroute, autoscaler rollback in progress. PD-INC-6721 remains acknowledged.

sasha: taking over watch. will run a follow-up postmortem and coordinate customer comms if p99 doesn't meet SLO by end of shift. thanks team.

pagerduty: PD: incident acknowledged by devon; escalation suppressed.
